data.long_meaning: The one who serves, assists, helps, obeys, or supports. in_arabic.name: عُبَيْدُون
in_arabic.meaning: عبد اللہ کا ایک کمزور خادم
in_arabic.long_meaning: عُبَيْدُون مشتق ہے عُبَيْد سے جو عَبْد کی معرب شکل ہے، یعنی اللہ تعالیٰ کا خادم، اور ضمہ کے ساتھ عُبَيْدون، یہ عربی زبان میں ایک محمود نام ہے جس کے معنی ہیں اللہ تعالیٰ کے خادم، خاص طور پر کمزور یا معمولی خادم

The rulings and commandments of Allah (God) are considered sacred, and followers are expected to adhere to them. Thus, the name Obaidun can be seen as a reminder of the spiritual duty to serve and obey God in every aspect of life, ultimately aiming for His pleasure. The individual named Obaidun may strive to embody the life principle of being an obedient servant of God, constantly seeking His guidance, support, and help.
